scenarios.title: Strong match
scenarios.description: A backend internship that fits the profile: evidence for every requirement.

scenarios.title: Low fit
scenarios.description: A senior SRE role: the agent flags the gaps and asks before tailoring anything.

scenarios.title: Vague posting
scenarios.description: A posting with no real requirements: the agent asks instead of guessing.

scenarios.title: Spanish posting
scenarios.description: A QA internship in Spanish: the CV and letter come out in Spanish.

scenarios.title: AI engineer intern
scenarios.description: Partial fit: honest about the gaps, strict about the evidence.

questions.title: About you
questions.prompt: Your name, contact details and what you are looking for.
hints: Current situation (studying X, working as Y) and the roles you want

questions.title: Work experience
questions.prompt: Jobs and internships, most recent first. Write freely, one per paragraph.
hints: Company, role, dates (month and year) and city
What you did and which tools you used
Results with numbers if you have them (users, time saved, size of the team)

questions.title: Projects
hints: What it does and why you built it
Anything measurable (users, stars, performance) and a link

questions.title: Education
hints: Relevant courses, thesis or a good grade

questions.title: Skills
questions.prompt: Languages, frameworks and tools you can actually work with.
hints: Only what you could discuss in an interview
Say where you used each one if it isn't obvious from above

questions.title: Languages
questions.prompt: Languages you speak and your level.

questions.title: Your current CV (optional)
questions.prompt: Paste the text of your current CV; it is used together with your answers.
hints: Copy-paste from the PDF or Word file; formatting does not matter
